create_MSELoss_with_default_scale: create an MSELoss instance with the default scale_param of 255.0 squared
create_MSELoss_with_custom_scale: create an MSELoss instance with a custom scale_param value for loss scaling
call_MSELoss_compute_loss: call MSELoss with an image and reference tensor to compute the scaled MSE loss
review_MSELoss_call_method: review the MSELoss __call__ method that multiplies F.mse_loss by scale_param
test_MSELoss_inheritance: test that MSELoss inherits from DistortionLoss and implements the __call__ interface
